Making objects with character is what I'm passionate about!
[vc_column_text el_class=”color-white”]Hi, I’m Adien, a Character Rigger based in Sydney, Australia, currently working at ILM Sydney as a Creature TD.

I specialize in rigging and simulation techniques using Python and Maya, constantly pushing creative boundaries. Outside of work, I dive into the visual arts through painting, photography, and videography, keeping my imagination sharp and fresh. Want to know more?

Click the button below to view my CV![/vc_column_text]
